sentences.text:
1 Reason: SLP (Crl.) No. 3194/2025 1  Mr. Sourav Singh, Adv.
 Ms.Chitransha Singh Sikarwar,Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel  the Court made the following  O R D E R 1) The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.363 of 2024 dated 30.10.2024 registered at Bhigwan Police Station, Taluka-Indapur, District Pune, Maharashtra, for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 223, 271, 275 of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Sections 26(2)(i), 26(2)
(iv), 27(3)(e) and 59(iii) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
2) While issuing notice on 28.03.2025, by way of interim relief, direction for not taking coercive steps subject to cooperation in the investigation, was issued.
3) Learned counsel for the  respondent-State has not disputed  that the petitioner has cooperated  with the investigation.

In that view of the matter and in the facts of this case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case,
we deem it appropriate to confirm the order of interim protection and deem it appropriate to release the petitioner on anticipatory bail, subject to his further cooperation in the investigation.

4) In view of the above, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner shall be released on bail on furnishing suitable bail bonds and sureties and on such other terms and conditions as may be deemed fit by the Station House Officer of the concerned police station.

5) We further direct that the  petitioner shall join the  investigation as and when required and co-operate in the same abiding all the conditions as specified under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2 6)

It is made clear here that violation, if any, by the petitioner, may give a cause to take recourse as permissible and the trial Court is at liberty to do the needful.
7) Accordingly, and in view of the foregoing, this special leave petition stands disposed of.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
